title: Remux – an open-source tmux workspace designed for iPhone
claim: Show HN: Remux – an open-source tmux workspace designed for iPhone
why_good: Remux taps into the growing trend of mobile productivity tools, catering to developers who want a seamless terminal experience on their iPhones.
value: The app could offer a subscription model for premium features, targeting developers and tech enthusiasts who need advanced functionalities on the go.
risk: The project may struggle to gain traction if larger companies release similar mobile solutions or if users prefer established desktop environments.
pick_reason: The project is an open-source tool that lacks a clear monetization strategy.
